_info: Stock (standard) configuration of ONE engine, loaded automatically when this engine is selected and by the button 'Load stock configuration'. File name = engine id. 'chargers': a catalog id (string) or {"profile": {...}, "count": n} for a part that belongs to this engine only. Maps use the shared rpm axis [800,2000,3500,5000,6000,7000] and load axis [0,25,50,75,100] ([loadIdx][rpmIdx]). 'reference' holds a known factory power figure for later calibration.
name: Honda D16 SOHC - stock configuration
generated: ignition and fuel maps derived from the shared base maps: rpm axis stretched to this engine's redline, fuel scaled by displacement per cylinder, ignition for a naturally aspirated engine (low-load row, 0.1 deg retard per % load)

reference.standard: PS as published by encycarpedia, converted to mechanical hp with 1 hp = 1.01387 PS
reference.variant: D16Y7 SOHC 1.6 L, 1996-2001 Civic Coupe 1.6i LS, 9.4:1, 75 x 90 mm
reference.source: encycarpedia.com 1996 Honda Civic Coupe 1.6i LS (D16Y7): 105 PS at 6200 rpm (listed as 104 BHP), 140 N·m at 4500 rpm, 9.4:1, 75 x 90 mm, SOHC
reference.notes: Engine code, 9.4:1 compression and 75 x 90 mm bore/stroke match the file, so this is the same spec. The encycarpedia entry gives 104 BHP and 105 PS; PS is used for consistency with the other entries. Other D16 variants are not used: D16A6 (111 BHP, 9.1:1), D16Y2 (VTEC, 123-124 BHP, 9.5:1) and D16Y8 (127 hp, 10.2:1 mismatch, see earlier note). The file's redline was not verified against a source.
